errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that all the challenges shown are related to financial obligations. The chart title is 'Main problems in mergers and acquisitions', and 'Financial difficulties' is only one of the five categories shown.
The slice for 'Интеграция на системи' (Integration of systems) is colored light red/coral, not blue ('синьо').
The slice for 'Културни различия' (Cultural differences) is colored light blue, not purple ('лилаво').

errors.text_span: от розово е „Загуба на ключови служители“
errors.evidence: The slice for 'Загуба на ключови служители' (Loss of key employees) is colored light green, not pink ('розово').
The slice for 'Друго' (Other) is colored grey, not green ('зелено').
The value for the 'Друго' (Other) category is 4.8%, not 16.7%.

errors.text_span: от тъмно синьо е „Загуба на ключови служители“ с 4.8%
errors.evidence: This part of the description incorrectly maps attributes. The 4.8% slice corresponds to the 'Друго' (Other) category and is colored grey, not 'Загуба на ключови служители' (Loss of key employees) and dark blue ('тъмно синьо'). The label 'Загуба на ключови служители' is incorrectly repeated.
The description completely omits the category 'Финансови затруднения' (Financial difficulties), which accounts for 16.7% of the pie chart and is colored yellow.
The description incorrectly states that the diagram includes a legend. The figure has labels next to the slices but no separate legend box.
